newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down two cents on higher offerings.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down two cents on higher offerings.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down two cents at 14.98 ringgit ($6.01) a kg, pressured by higher offerings at the opening, traders said.
"Despite a slightly higher LME close on Friday, local tin price fell due to initial high offerings," said one trader.
Traders noted offers for 147 tonnes against bids for 121 tonnes at the opening. Final turnover was 121 tonnes, down from 141 on Friday, and buyers were from Europe and Malaysia.
Traders expect the price to hold around 15.00 ringgit this week. The local premium over LME narrowed to $20 a tonne against $35 previously.--Syed Azman (603-230-8911) ($1=2.4930 ringgit)
